headline: Norway's $2.3 Trillion Sovereign Wealth Fund Loses $30B in Q3
summary: Norway's Government Pension Fund Global booked a loss of $30 billion for the third quarter. The world's biggest sovereign wealth fund cited higher interest rates and market turbulence hitting both fixed-income and equity investments.
why: Norway's sovereign wealth fund manages massive state oil and gas revenues, acting as one of the most influential institutional investors in global financial markets.
